svg.title: Done when (each item has a check)
svg.desc: #: 1, Outcome: Every command below works through the CLI and through MCP, against the same live tabs, Check: e2e suite, one test per command per transport; #: 2, Outcome: Invisible: no visible window (except sign-in or handoff), no Dock icon, never takes focus, Check: Suite asserts every Umbra on-screen window has alpha 0 and the frontmost app is unchanged; #: 3, Outcome: Fast: warm snapshot p50 < 25 ms, click < 40 ms, local navigate < 120 ms; cold first command < 700 ms; one-shot read < 500 ms, Check: bench/ results committed, compared against Playwright when installed; #: 4, Outcome: Robust daemon: auto-spawn, idle exit, stale-socket recovery, concurrent clients, one-shots routed through a live daemon, Check: lifecycle tests; #: 5, Outcome: Agents succeed: fresh agents given only the skill or MCP tools complete realistic tasks on fixture sites, Check: eval report, at least 90% pass; #: 6, Outcome: Existing callers unharmed: FIRST, plus UBC Canvas, Kaltura and ubccheck, Check: their tests and live checks; #: 7, Outcome: Shipped: README, docs, llms.txt, skill, CI, pushed, Check: GitHub page reviewed
